title: assure.AttestationStore
description: Not written yet. Hands a statement to the provider's attestation action and fetches attestations for a commit through the provider's API; the product's repository holds nothing.

title: assure.VerdictStore
description: Not written yet. Writes a verdict to the CI job's output and, for a passed release, hands it to the provider's attestation action.

title: compiler.ResolveDependencies
description: ResolveDependencies runs Go's module tools on the captured source and saves go.mod and go.sum through the apply journal.

title: appbuild.Download
description: Download writes the zips and module-cache.json into a new folder, and the build reads that record back.

title: appbuild.Build
description: Build writes build.json and the executable into a new result folder.

title: appbuild.BuildImage
description: BuildImage writes the OCI layout and image.json into a new folder; PublishImage and RetrieveImage move it to and from a registry.

title: parser.Parse
description: Parse reads a declaration from its file through the strict decoder in strict.go. STEGO writes a declaration only when it scaffolds one; an author or an agent changes it by editing the file.

title: lifecycle.Store
description: Not written yet: STEGO keeps no digest lifecycle today. It will read the lifecycle records from the registry's current head and write them beside the registry.

title: runs_at
description: runs_at, run_jobs, run_artifacts and tag_ref read the release's runs, jobs, artifacts and tag at one commit from GitHub. qualify writes the qualification record to a new result folder.

title: verification.verify
description: verify authenticates the compiler and its build record, then copies both into the new result folder.

title: parser.ParseFill
description: ParseFill reads fills/<name>/fill.yaml through the strict decoder. STEGO writes fill.yaml when it scaffolds a fill; nothing writes evidence or a sign-off into it yet.

title: compiler.LoadState
description: LoadState reads .stego/state.yaml through the strict decoder, and decodeState refuses a record that breaks its rules. SaveState writes it, and commitTransaction in transaction.go saves the record last, after the generated files.

title: registry.LoadDirectories
description: LoadDirectories captures one through eight registry sources, refuses an artifact or an input file that occurs in more than one source, and indexes every archetype, component and mixin. STEGO never writes a registry; a platform engineer changes it by editing its files.

title: Registry.Archetype
description: LoadDirectories parses each archetypes/<name>/archetype.yaml and each mixin, and Registry.Archetype and Registry.Mixin return them by name.

title: registry.LoadPorts
description: Not written yet: a port exists today only as a name on the components that require or provide it. This names where a port with its meaning and fields will load from.

title: Registry.checkSlots
description: LoadDirectories reads each component's and each mixin's slots with the component, and checkSlots finds the protobuf contract of each one.
